item.meta_description: This Compendium aims to provide users with a comprehensive and accessible source of information on the Consumer Prices Index, including owner occupiers’ Housing costs (CPIH). This Compendium will focus chiefly on the measurement of Owner Occupiers’ Housing costs (OOH).
